description: Role labels drift from project-roles.md's canonical names in multiple, independent places - now a recurring pattern, not a one-off. cmek.md cites the role via anchor '#project-cluster-manager-role' and label 'Project/Cluster Manager' vs. project-roles.md's plain 'Cluster Manager'. Separately (round 7), analytics-links.md's prose says 'Cluster Data / Reader' while linking to the anchor manage-documents.md uses for 'Data Writer' - a label/anchor mismatch on a different role. Two independent instances of the same underlying problem: role labels aren't consistently copied from their one authoritative source.
foundDuring: round 6 (89-page cloud/ management-plane sweep); generalized in round 7 (53-page cloud/clusters/ sweep) after a second, unrelated instance - id kept as originally minted despite now describing a broader pattern
